title: thalictrum majus var. nutans
intro: Thalictrum majus var. nutans, commonly known as Lady's Mantle or Lady's Calm, is a perennial flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving menstrual cramps, heavy bleeding, and other symptoms associated with premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle are attributed to its ability to tone the uterus, reduce inflammation, and exhibit anticoagulant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
